analysis_kind: Offline analysis of an existing user-operated capture; ordinary local decoder evidence.
capture_source: Original-client user operation; existing PCAPdroid TCP export already closed.
source_line_definition: 1-based line in the unmodified hero-levels-decoded.jsonl; directions emitted separately, not in global timestamp order.

post_upgrade_gift.note: After all level/break requests; excluded from growth-cost calculations.

sanitization: Only hero 13 gameplay/state, assets, growth commands, resonance baseline, breakthrough material 10001 and gift 99955. Raw payloads, network addresses, authentication, role/account identity, chat and unrelated commands excluded. Array selections marked on each altered frame.
limitations: Packet data establishes level changes, not the exact button label or historical UI screenshots.
Three breakthroughs changed attributes and unlocked skills; compare pure leveling only within a fixed break step.
All successful costs match this client table, but material-shortage and partial-level paths were not sampled.
Exact original growth and power formula remains unknown; local base formula does not reproduce the observed attributes.
The weighted local power function fed captured attributes is 2 to 5 below the observed power.
The gift after all growth operations adds resources; final capture balances must not be treated as post-upgrade balances.
Receiver closure and a clean decode do not prove lossless observation of network traffic.
